description: Source code implementing distributed data samplers (random and sequential) for PyTorch, including methods for iteration, resetting, saving, and loading sampler state.

classes.name: DistributedRandomSampler
classes.description: A sampler that provides random, distributed sampling of data indices with support for saving and loading state.

classes.name: DistributedSequentialSampler
classes.description: A sampler that provides sequential, distributed sampling of data indices with support for saving and loading state.

methods.name: DistributedRandomSampler::next
methods.description: Returns the next batch of randomly sampled indices.

methods.name: DistributedRandomSampler::reset
methods.description: Resets the sampler, optionally with a new dataset size, and shuffles indices.

methods.name: DistributedRandomSampler::populate_indices
methods.description: Populates the indices vector with data indices, possibly duplicating to match total sample count.

methods.name: DistributedRandomSampler::save
methods.description: Saves the current sampler state (sample index and epoch) to an archive.

methods.name: DistributedRandomSampler::load
methods.description: Loads the sampler state (sample index and epoch) from an archive.

methods.name: DistributedSequentialSampler::next
methods.description: Returns the next sequential batch of data indices.

methods.name: DistributedSequentialSampler::reset
methods.description: Resets the sampler, optionally with a new dataset size.

methods.name: DistributedSequentialSampler::populate_indices
methods.description: Populates the indices vector with sequential data indices.

methods.name: DistributedSequentialSampler::save
methods.description: Saves the current sampler state to an archive.

methods.name: DistributedSequentialSampler::load
methods.description: Loads the sampler state from an archive.
